name: Mariner
body:
You are equally at home above or below the water.

Prerequisite(s): favored terrain (water) class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain a +2 bonus to Profession (sailor) and Swim checks. You can always take 10 on Swim checks, you never need to make concentration or Acrobatics checks due to rough waters, and you add your character level when determining the number of rounds you can hold your breath.

Character Options: The Ranger. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum.
